identity.title: Split GitHub tool surface into smaller owner binaries

values.summary: Add shared resilience crate, narrow GitHub owner binaries, install/coexistence enforcement, and focused validation.

steps.action: Add shared resilience retry/backoff crate and wire C-SDLC/runtime users.
Add split GitHub issue and PR owner binaries while preserving compatibility facade.
Update install/coexistence manifests and Gate 10A tests for the full required binary set.
Update current docs and operator skill guidance for the split GitHub surface.
Repair current bootstrap validation guidance away from deleted structured-prompt shell wrappers.
Run focused validation and stable install/coexistence proof.

invariants: GitHub mutation paths must reconcile exact markers after writes
Stable binary install must be generated from reviewed source, not target-cache assumptions
csdlc-merge remains present in required binary set
risks: Old stable csdlc-install embeds stale manifest until refreshed from new source
Compatibility facade could mask split-binary regressions without explicit rejection tests
